data.title: 墨染希 · 和室榻榻米的午后微醺
data.description: 夏日午后的神社厢房里，庭院风铃叮当作响。希蜷缩在蔺草清香的榻榻米上，薄薄的棉被搭在腰际。微风拂过她柔顺的短发，当感觉到身旁有人躺下时，她迷迷糊糊地伸出双臂环抱住对方的手臂，嘴角扬起甜甜的梦呓。
data.action: sleeping on tatami, hugging arm, gentle breeze moving curtains
data.lighting: dappled garden sunlight filtering through paper shoji
data.promptProse: Napping peacefully on a woven tatami mat in the breezy shrine room, Sumizome Nozomi hugs the viewer's arm like a plush cushion in her sleep. The sound of a wind chime echoes as soft green garden shadows ripple across her innocent sleeping face. Only the viewer's arm enters the frame.
data.animaCaption: Nozomi sleeps on the tatami while hugging the viewer's arm; only the arm enters the frame.
